thread:
megan: noticed an odd blip on the fncall validator during the small canary flip. Reject rate jumped to ~3.6% in 5m for variant rwd-mix:canary-1. Raising here for quick decision.
art: what’s the error class? parse_error vs type_mismatch? any sample payloads?
sylvia: validator logs show "type_mismatch: expected object but received array". Example sanitized line: ```{
  "route":"/v1/invoke",
  "variant":"rwd-mix:canary-1",
  "err":"type_mismatch",
  "expected":"object",
  "actual":"array",
  "resp": ["ok"]
}```
megan: hmm. this smells like a model-side change to how tool responses are wrapped. Could be a missing object wrapper in the tool adaptor.
art: short options: 1) roll back the canary slice; 2) route failing responses to permissive adapter that coalesces arrays -> {"text": value}; 3) leave as is and capture more samples. Tradeoffs: rollback = immediate safety, shim = preserves traffic but masks breaks, leave = customer impact.
sre: revert is lowest blast radius and fastest. KV cache keys are variant-scoped so rollback won't corrupt caches.
observability-bot: Alert: fncall_validation_rejects > 3% (5m) route=/v1/invoke variant=rwd-mix:canary-1 region=us-east-1. Suggested quick panel: "fncall rejects by variant (live samples)". Create? :robot_face:
billing: FYI our billing pipeline tags requests by initial routing policy. If the router transparently rewrites to a permissive path we still count against the original strict bucket unless we add a route_tag header. Adding header support requires small billing ingest changes and a backfill plan (ETA ~48h).
sylvia: given billing fuzz and risk of hiding a real regression I vote to rollback and collect N=250 scrubbed failing samples (prompt + response) for model team. We'll run compatibility tests locally.
megan: agreed. canary rollback started. Also add a sampling hook that stores scrubbed samples to s3://redwood-debug/fncall/1850001111/ with TTL 7d. Include a brief repro harness for model owners.
art: opened ENG-4041 to track: sampling, dashboard tile, billing header spec, and compatibility tests. Assigning to eng-platform + billing.
sre: rollback complete. traffic back to rwd-mix:stable. rejects returning to baseline.
observability-bot: Dashboard tile created: fncall rejects by variant (panel id: dash-4041). Linked sample store.
billing: will draft route_tag header spec and a minimal ingest change proposal. Will post PR to internal billing repo and estimate backfill approach.
megan: follow-ups: 1) model-team run compatibility harness against strict validator, 2) eng-platform add internal console toggle to suppress canary-window accounting alerts (opt-in + audit log), 3) billing implement route_tag header plan. I'll own the postmortem if needed.
sylvia: added scrubber rules: remove emails, tokens, long verbatim user content. samples ready for model-team handoff.
megan: thanks all. closing for now — keep ENG-4041 updated if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
